items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I didn't know him personally, but I know him.

ctx.x: I didn't know him personally, but I know him. Yeah. Know saxophone player named T-Boy? Yeah.
You did know a saxophone player? Yeah. Yeah. I know there was a trumpet. That was T-Boy, Rémy
Dominique Rémy. Yeah, I know him too. Rémy. And T-Boy Barberin, Paul Barberin. Paul, Paul Barberin.
